text:
mina: Bringing up a new 13B candidate (ozma-lite-13b-quant). Quick sanity checks + speculative-decode config thoughts. TL;DR: offline eval mostly green, short-prompt speedups are good but spec hit-rate low on <=25 token prompts. Need a canary plan.

andrew: numbers?

mina: Offline sweep (5k prompts, mixed chat/code/docs) results:```
baseline (no-spec): median_latency_ms=120, p95_ms=260
speculative (2-stage beamless): median_latency_ms=70, p95_ms=190
spec_hit_rate=36% overall, 22% for prompts <=25 tokens
quality_deltas: code-BLEU +0.8, chat-winrate -0.6% (paired A/B)
```

jess: quant details? 4bit or 8bit? per-channel/fused? any KV drift observed?

mina: 8-bit QAT -> dynamic int8 paths. FFN per-tensor, attention per-channel. Simulated 10k-step KV walkthrough: kv-drift ~0.1% token-mismatch on long-history (>1024) cases — negligible but logged.

simon: Suggest canary: 1% prod traffic w/ shadow logging; if no metric-regressions after 6h -> 5%, after 24h -> 10%. Auto-rollback triggers: chat-winrate drop >1.0% OR spec_hit_rate <30% on short prompts OR p95 latency > 230ms.

andrew: Also add live eval hooks: regen-rate, user-abandon (front-end metric), token-fallback rate, and a small human rating slice for contentious cases.

mina: Worth noting: speculative config we used:```
speculative:
  enabled: true
  max_prefill_tokens: 32
  early_abort_thresh: 0.25
  fallback_order: [quant8, fp16]
  warm_prefix_cache: true
```

jess: What were the failure modes in the 5k run?

mina: Short list: 1) safe/defensive replies sometimes worse under spec stage (4 regressions flagged by heuristic), 2) one KG-QA hallucination cluster (same prompt family) — traced to sampling seed alignment, 3) slightly higher repetition on multi-turn creative prompts. I pasted a sample failed chat below:```
User: "Summarize my note: ..."
Baseline: "TL;DR: makes 3 points..."
Spec: "TL;DR: makes 3 points... plus invented detail about X that isn't in the note"
```

simon: For the canary we should create two holdouts: short-turns (<25 tokens) and provenance-sensitive prompts (KG/finance/health). Track hit-rate separately per holdout. If short-turn hit-rate <40% after 1h, kill.

andrew: Operational checklist:
- instrument spec_hit_rate, per-route latency, p95 token throughput
- attach eval-bot to sample 50 rejected/failed responses hourly for quick human triage
- run nightly offline run with updated prompts (we'll keep rolling 1k newest events)

eval-bot: automated-summary: "spec-canary ready. baseline_p95=260ms, spec_p95=190ms, short_prompt_spec_hit_rate=22%. Recommended canary knobs: initial_traffic=1%, monitor_list=[chat-winrate,regen-rate,spec_hit_short]."

mina: Next steps: 1) @andrew add canary job and dashboard widgets; 2) @jess push quant build to canary infra; 3) @simon draft rollback rules into runbook. I'll open a short PR with the config snippet and the offline CSV. :thumbsup:

andrew: will do. starting canary job now.

jess: uploading quant artifacts to s3/ozma/canary/2026-03-23.tar.gz

simon: drafting runbook, will ping for review. :ok_hand:
